definitions.gloss: gentle; mild; even-tempered (of a person or climate)
definitions.explanation: Describes a calm, gentle quality with no harshness — used both for a mild, agreeable climate and for a calm, even-tempered personality.

examples.japanese: {温和|おんわ}な{気候|きこう}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{温和|おんわ}な{性格|せいかく}だ。
この{地方|ちほう}は{一年|いちねん}を{通|とお}して{温和|おんわ}で{過|す}ごしやすい。
examples.english: This region is mild and comfortable to live in throughout the year.

notes:
Applies both to weather/climate and to temperament. Conveys calmness and the absence of anything harsh or extreme.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {温和|おんわ}な{気候|きこう}: a mild climate
- {温和|おんわ}な{性格|せいかく}: a gentle personality
- {温和|おんわ}な{人柄|ひとがら}: a mild-mannered character

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {穏和|おんわ}: gentle; moderate — a variant spelling used mainly for temperament or moderate opinions; {温和|おんわ} additionally covers a mild climate
- {穏|おだ}やか: calm; peaceful — broader, also describes a calm sea, mood, or atmosphere
